name: Axis
description: An upright, poster-clean template for chiropractors and spine clinics — bone paper, deep indigo ink and one vermilion accent, tall condensed headlines with a photo set right into the line, a hand-built S-curved spine map where every condition lights up the vertebrae it lives in, a sixty-minute first visit laid out on a ruler, and a book-your-first-visit call to action at both ends of the page.
